The gender/Bangla member (9a619736...) equals F1s' + RFX' per pair: that is all 13.54 takes from this group.

Selection of this file (declaration): FVBIND failed its pre-registered validation gate 2 (t163p_fvb/original/evidence/gate2_report_194/fvbg2_report.txt:15 'GATE 2: FAIL -> keep FACTOR_ENFUSE, paper only'). posteval_FVBIND_ENFUSE_fvb.zip was then submitted to the Evaluation phase (CodaBench submission 1053013, 15/11/2026, cells 14.29 / 12.22 / 22.12 / 18.99), and its gender/Bangla file was chosen cell by cell from Evaluation scores (18.99 against 20.11 for FACTOR_ENFUSE; a_best4_ref/original/make_probes.py KNOWN :36-38, BEST_NOW :112). The 13.54 zip keeps that file. Choosing on Evaluation scores is against question 11 of the organisers' FAQ; declared in stages/60_fvbind/README.md and docs/COMPLIANCE_NOTES.md.
